notes.title: Dev Update & Build 0.1.2 Trailer!
notes.notes:
Survivors, our latest dev update is here—along with a brand-new trailer! 🎬

We've been hard at work refining core gameplay! Our latest backer demo update (0.1.2) introduces melee combat 🥊, an improved gear screen ⚙️ for shoulder-slotting weapons, roaming wolf packs 🐺, sleeping in beds 🛏️, and more! Whether you're fighting bandits, managing gear, or securing a safe place to rest, survival is getting deeper.

We've been hard at work on the next update and I can't wait to share more soon! 

[previewyoutube=uwLIBtW8yA0;full][/previewyoutube]

🔹 The demo Build 0.1.2 is currently available to existing backers and anyone else who backs us on indiegogo can play now.  We do updates to the build every month or two leading up to our upcoming steam release.

Stay tuned for more updates later this month!  Thanks for all the support.
